name: Utpaladeva (Utpalacarya)
summary: Founder of the Pratyabhijna school: the Isvarapratyabhijnakarika argues recognition (self, already established, re-cognises itself as the Lord) so ordinary people may realise without strain. Also theologian of the knower (Siddhitrayi) and bhakti poet (Sivastotravali). Vivrti survives only in fragments; arrangement of the Stotravali is by disciples/organizers, not assumed authorial sequence.
